paragraphs: Rav Chana bar Katina: Taanit 13a; Yoma 54a; Yevamot 79a; Kiddushin 77b; Bekhorot 37b. His brother was R. Daniel; see there. Student of Rav Huna—I have not found this. Gittin 38a, near the end, has Rav Chanina son of Rav Katina saying in Rav Yitzchak's name. That matter at 43b has Rav Huna son of Rav Katina. Chullin 19a: Rav Chanan bar Katina said to Rav Nachman.
